Risk: Wrong PCB revision, touch IC or antenna
Evidence now: Vendor drawings and STEP; receiving sample open
Test method: Photograph both PCB faces, revision, RF layout, connectors and kit speaker; compare pinout to controlled schematic.
Acceptance and record: Pinout, panel, flash, PSRAM and purchase configuration trace to the same lot. Hold mismatches for engineering review.

Risk: Reversed battery polarity or crushed splice
Evidence now: Adapter part numbers; connector compatibility open
Test method: With all power removed, test net-to-net continuity and polarity independently at both mating ends; inspect insulation with a reference mating plug.
Acceptance and record: Positive-to-BAT+ and negative-to-ground only. No cross-short, exposed strands or strained cell tab. Record readings and keyed drawing.

Risk: Overcharge or wrong defaults before firmware starts
Evidence now: Code programs 4.20 V / 300 mA and reads both settings back
Test method: Use a battery simulator first. Capture input, pack voltage and current before boot, in bootloader, off, during reset, with erased flash and while playing.
Acceptance and record: Every state meets ordered pack voltage, current and temperature limits including instrument uncertainty. Capture cutoff, restart and termination. Escalate any uncontrolled default.

Risk: Two-wire pack has no pack thermistor terminal
Evidence now: Temperature-qualified charge inhibit remains unresolved
Test method: Characterize at pack vendor operating boundaries using a qualified battery lab. Verify hardware protection and abnormal/restart behavior at cell, charger and accessible surface.
Acceptance and record: Approved thermal sensing or qualified independent charge protection on production SKU. Attach recorded temperature curves and vendor limits.

Risk: Radio, speaker, motor and LCD coincide at low battery
Evidence now: Behavioral supply model; board rail waveforms open
Test method: Scope directly across local rail and ground with short return; record pack leads and current concurrently. Repeat at low/mid/full state, USB present/absent, Wi-Fi TX, music, new catches and motor bursts.
Acceptance and record: No rail outside each IC operating range, reset, touch failure or save corruption. Record rail minimum, recovery, current, test conditions and capture bandwidth.

Risk: C-to-C failure, unstable attach, failed data enumeration
Evidence now: USB-C integrated on A1
Test method: Try A-to-C and C-to-C data cables in both orientations; enumerate, flash, charge and hot-plug with pack present and absent. Lab tests exposed connector and shell under applicable ESD plan.
Acceptance and record: No unsafe heating, inverted plug failure or corruption. USB recovery works after stress; record host, cable, VBUS and device identifiers.

Risk: Parallel pull-ups, capacitive loading or marginal low level
Evidence now: 400 kHz shared SDA GPIO8 / SCL GPIO7
Test method: Measure at J8 and farthest peripheral for base and rumble BOMs using a low-capacitance probe. Add longest allowed W1 and record rise, fall, VOL, timeout and retries.
Acceptance and record: Meets applicable Fast-mode electrical timing and every device sink limit. Log actual pull-up network, probe capacitance and waveform; no stuck bus.

Risk: Imperfect magnet alignment, wrong polarity or motor interference
Evidence now: 1.20 mm nominal face-to-sensor-package gap; 12 software teeth per turn
Test method: Sweep CW/CCW across wrap; repeat with fold positions and rumble off/high. Capture AS5600 raw angle, time and magnet status.
Acceptance and record: Correct sign, monotonic unwrapped response and no missing/weak/strong flags. A full slow turn yields 12 clicks; an idle reel adds zero.

Risk: Reversed axes, unstable zero or false casts from vibration
Evidence now: Host gesture tests and raw API; QMI8658 configured ±4 g / 125 Hz
Test method: Capture two poses then repeatedly lift, lower, cast and hold still through audio, motor and RF bursts. Query raw accelerometer/gyro API.
Acceptance and record: Lift raises the displayed rod; deliberate casts increment once. Stationary fixture produces zero casts/lifts during each 60 s stress run. Preserve raw traces.

Risk: False contacts, glass preload, inverted corners
Evidence now: 0.25 mm nominal glass/rim air gap; nine-target software diagnostic
Test method: Run before assembly and after closure on battery and USB. Tap nine targets, inspect each edge, swipe journal and test while gripping accessory.
Acceptance and record: 9/9 hits within ±12 logical px per axis; no idle contacts or drag dropout. Record case flatness and actual glass clearance.

Risk: Shorted bridge output, clipping or overload
Evidence now: 16 kHz mixer and enumerated speaker assembly
Test method: Start on suitable differential dummy load. Use a differential probe across speaker leads; listen on final speaker to level steps, clicks, bite cues and stem changes.
Acceptance and record: Mute works, levels increase, current and differential RMS stay inside driver and received speaker ratings; no persistent clipping, hot spots or enclosure buzz.

Risk: Overdriven ERM, stalled output or excessive cross-talk
Evidence now: DRV2605L at 0x5A; firmware waveforms and optional missing-device path
Test method: Capture differential motor voltage/current for the longest hold, rapid clicks and optional module absent. Log IMU, encoder and supply together.
Acceptance and record: Output stops on cancel/Off; rating met at tolerance corners. User can distinguish prawn, ray and run. No false casts or encoder flags.

Risk: 0.05 mm nominal free gap consumed by tolerances
Evidence now: Omron actuator height tolerance alone is ±0.20 mm
Test method: Gauge fitted gap and closure before top cap stop. Check continuity in several pocket/grip orientations. Repeat boot/shutdown on pack and USB.
Acceptance and record: Open at rest, repeatable single press, no preload, independent original key operation. Log approx. 1 s startup / 4 s shutdown and USB-powered behavior.

Risk: Wire pinched, tab flexed or pouch compressed
Evidence now: 0.40 mm nominal pack-to-fence lateral gap
Test method: Use dimensioned inert pack surrogate at supplier maximum envelope; inspect both housing halves. Dress harnesses and observe closure with witness material clear of the real pouch.
Acceptance and record: No compression or marks on surrogate, no sharp contacts or trapped leads. Freeze maximum cell/PCM/lead exit dimensions before ordering tooling.

Risk: Grip rocks or pulls out; threaded nut rotates
Evidence now: 35 mm dovetail, M3 metal threads, sampled rigid-body motion
Test method: On unpowered housing, measure tip play; apply ±9 N at 112 mm about each transverse axis and 30 N axial for 10 s per grip procedure. Repeat after 100 attachment cycles.
Acceptance and record: Record displacement under load and after unloading, rail damage, screw loosening and nut pullout. Approve production torque and play thresholds only with run data.

Risk: Magnet or hinge hardware released after wear/drop
Evidence now: Nominal swept fit and printed coupon; fatigue unmeasured
Test method: Cycle fold and spin on production material, then conduct chosen age-grade drop, abuse, torque and small-part evaluations with test lab.
Acceptance and record: No accessible detached magnet or unintended exposed fixing. Reel folds completely, retained parts and click count remain functional.

Risk: Hand, steel hardware, cell or motor detunes antenna
Evidence now: Onboard antenna; full-product radio evidence absent
Test method: Compare conducted/OTA reference board and closed device with handle fitted/removed, reel folded/extended, hand positions, charging and haptic load.
Acceptance and record: Record link budget, antenna performance, retries and applicable margin with RF lab; freeze antenna keep-out and production radio profile.

Risk: Pond time drifts after offline play or power removal
Evidence now: 0x51 RTC, phone Wi-Fi setup, Bangkok display time
Test method: Sync against UTC reference. Log offset at 0 h, 24 h and 72 h with radio off. Repeat after battery removal with actual backup configuration.
Acceptance and record: No silent invalid time. Report measured drift and holdover duration by SKU; define saleable holdover spec from result.

Risk: Advertising hours inferred from capacity alone
Evidence now: 1200 mAh nominal; power modes measurable after build
Test method: Log pack-side coulombs and Wh to controlled cutoff during low, typical, and max audio/display/radio/haptic workloads. Repeat off-state over 24 h.
Acceptance and record: Document brightness, music level, events, ambient temperature, pack lot and end condition. Publish only measured play hours and storage drain.

Risk: Inaccessible instruments or lost recovery after update
Evidence now: ESP32-S3 image built; version 1 raw sensor/power/bus API
Test method: Read IMU raw frames, fast/slow wheel, clock, power and gauge. Disable/re-enable gyro. Flash a known-good image over accessible USB and restore play.
Acceptance and record: API units, signed direction and validity flags agree with references. Save serial, firmware digest and recovery log.

Risk: Failed update strands device or loses the journal
Evidence now: Two 3 MiB slots; signature/health checks in source
Test method: Use owned test keys and feed. Test good signed image, wrong target/version/signature, incomplete transfer, low power and post-boot health failure. Retest USB recovery.
Acceptance and record: Only authentic compatible image activates; previous playable image available after failed activation. Confirm journal, controls and time survive and log both digests.

Risk: Phone behavior mistaken for physical sensor/audio evidence
Evidence now: 52 species; 117 waters; 468 scene variants; host and browser regressions
Test method: Test actual float drift, jig and spoon; replay prawn, ray and runner, then view record, time, gear, settings and rewards on real LCD.
Acceptance and record: Hidden fish until landed; settings persist; visual cues usable muted. Record readability of Atkinson type and touch targets under intended light.

Risk: Production promise exceeds network implementation
Evidence now: Hosted browser events and board-local events use separate rooms
Test method: Join two physical units to the same supported room; log round ID, idempotent catch count, dropout and reconnect. Separately test two phone profiles.
Acceptance and record: No duplicated score after retries. Explicitly label supported host, player count, account model and network need per release.

Risk: Wrong mark or market release scope
Evidence now: Planning matrix for Thailand, US and EU; no product grant attached
Test method: Agree SKU, age grade, radio modes, adapter, battery and accessories with local conformity partner. Test complete sale configuration and retain reports.
Acceptance and record: Written market applicability, matching reports and authorized markings, declarations, labeling and test-summary records by region.

Risk: Pilot yield hides intermittent harness or cap fit
Evidence now: Gerbers, print assets and station sequence available
Test method: Build with proposed line tools and real suppliers; record first-pass yield and defect by station, rework, calibration status and serial-to-lot trace.
Acceptance and record: Approved first article, supplier revisions, drawing/firmware hashes, measured yield and cost within signed business case.

Risk: Repair damages battery or shipment lacks paperwork
Evidence now: USB recovery and removable accessory; approved production pack open
Test method: Service drill: replace pack per approved procedure, test seal/fit, restore unit and inspect data. Obtain exact pack UN 38.3 summary and packout classification.
Acceptance and record: Traceable battery documents, packaging and service procedure; warranty owner and firmware support horizon assigned.
